name: voice-en-standard

settings.script_check: faster-whisper small.en, PASS at >= 90% word match; FLAG does not fail the job

notes: English voice-overs. Only voices listed in 'choices' are allowed; new voices need Homi's listening approval. Every voice-over is human-reviewed (Stage 2). From v0.2 (receiver v0.10, VL1-VL6): levelled by gain + limiter at -2 dB (4x oversampled), re-measured up to 4 rounds, so short clips also reach -16 LUFS; fails if more than +20 dB is needed. v0.3 (9 Oct 2026, S8): four more voices approved by Homi after listening to samples: af_bella (US female, warmer), am_michael (US male), bm_george (British male), bf_emma (British female).
